proposals.issue_title: Fragile & Fragmented Image Generation APIs Across Pipelines
proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines have hardcoded, separate API calls. When Hugging Face, AI Horde, or Gemini block/rate-limit GHA runners, all pipelines break silently. Pollinations is the only working fallback but produces sub-optimal quality.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a unified Python module `image_gateway.py` with an automated fallback matrix. The gateway attempts: 1. Together AI (FLUX-schnell, free tier), 2. Cloudflare Workers AI (10k free daily neurons), 3. Runware (PAYG, capped at $20/month as premium option), 4. Pollinations (ultimate fallback). All pipelines must import this single gateway.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: 100% pipeline resilience, zero manual code updates when API providers change, automatically utilizes the highest quality available model.

proposals.issue_title: Manual Asset Download and Upload Pain on Mobile (Termux)
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo only has an Android phone. Downloading massive ZIPs of generated coloring books or SVG packs to Termux/phone storage to manually upload them to Redbubble, Cults3D, or KDP is highly inefficient and consumes phone data.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a 'Pre-signed Delivery' step. Have GHA automatically commit successful assets to a public/private Hugging Face Dataset repository or a GitHub Release, then generate a simple, mobile-friendly HTML index page hosted on GitHub Pages. Hugo can view, select, and directly upload files to platforms via his mobile browser without downloading them to Termux first.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves hours of phone file management, reduces mobile data usage, and visualizes generated products instantly.

proposals.issue_title: Missing Visual Quality Gate for AI Gibberish and Artifacts
proposals.current_pain_description: FLUX-schnell and other generators can occasionally output broken anatomy, overlapping lines, or corrupted text. Publishing these on KDP or Redbubble ruins store reputation and wastes upload slots.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate `agent_gemini_quality_check` directly into the GHA workflow as a hard gate. Use the free `gemini-2.5-flash` multimodal API to analyze the generated image. Prompt: 'Verify if this coloring page has clean black and white lines, no grayscale gradients, and no gibberish text.' If it fails, auto-retry image generation once with a modified prompt.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents low-quality products from reaching platforms, protecting seller account health.

proposals.issue_title: GHA Quota Burn and Silent Job Hangs
proposals.current_pain_description: Without explicit timeouts, GHA jobs waiting on API responses or stuck in infinite loops can run for up to 6 hours, exhausting Hugo's free 2,000 monthly GHA minutes in a single day.
proposals.proposed_fix: Enforce a strict `timeout-minutes: 15` on all GHA jobs. Add a lightweight Python wrapper that sends a fast, free webhook notification (via Telegram Bot API or Discord Webhook) to Hugo's phone whenever a GHA workflow fails or succeeds, detailing exactly what failed.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Zero wasted GHA minutes, immediate notification on mobile without checking GitHub Actions tab.

proposals.current_pain_description: An asset generated for a book (e.g., a literal idiom illustration or quote design) is only used for that book. This wastes the computational cost and prompt engineering of that asset.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a post-processing script `cross_pollinate.py` to successful runs. If a high-quality transparent PNG illustration is generated, the script should automatically: 1. Format it as a Redbubble sticker (transparent PNG), 2. Format it as a Kindle lockscreen wallpaper, 3. Package it into a digital SVG/PNG clipart pack for Etsy. Output all three formats into the release directory.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: 3x the product listings for the same API token and generation cost.

proposals.current_pain_description: Even if the files are generated, Hugo has to manually write titles, descriptions, and tags/keywords on his phone browser when uploading to KDP, Cults3D, or Redbubble.
proposals.proposed_fix: Force every production pipeline to output a standardized `metadata.json` containing: `title`, `description` (optimized with keywords), `tags` (comma-separated), and `suggested_price`. Use Gemini to generate these during the pipeline. Render these details in the HTML index page (Proposal 2) with a 'Copy to Clipboard' button for quick mobile uploading.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces mobile listing upload time from 10 minutes to less than 2 minutes per product.

proposals.issue_title: Unvalidated Parametric STL Generation for Cults3D
proposals.current_pain_description: Parametric 3D designs (OpenSCAD/Python-based) can easily generate non-manifold (non-watertight) meshes or empty files if the parameters collide. Selling broken STL files on Cults3D leads to instant bad reviews and refund requests.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a validation step in the STL pipeline using the Python `numpy` or `trimesh` library (lightweight, runs easily in GHA). The script must verify: 1. The mesh is closed (watertight), 2. The volume is positive, 3. The file size is correct. If invalid, discard and log the parameters.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Guarantees 100% printable 3D models, preventing negative reviews on Cults3D.
